$comment: Registry of the files that declare Ranger operators. docs/tools reads this file to build the operator reference. A file in the tree with an `operators { }` block or an `operator type:` block that is not listed here fails docs:coverage. `status` is `stable` (documented) or `legacy` (listed on the not-covered page, with no reference pages). Measure the usage before a change of status: a legacy file is one that no maintained program imports.
